department: Doctoral Programme in Chemical Engineering (CHEM), School of Chemical Engineering

deadline.value: Application round 30 Sep to 3 Nov 2026 (23:59 UTC+2); the programme has four rounds a year (Jan, May, Sep, Nov). 2027 rounds were not yet published.
